root_cause.text: In `sched_ext`’s `is_bpf_migration_disabled()` helper (`kernel/sched/ext_idle.c`), the code unconditionally treated `p == current` as evidence that `migration_disabled == 1` came from the BPF prolog, but on kernels without `CONFIG_PREEMPT_RCU` the BPF prolog never calls `migrate_disable()`, so this check falsely returned “not migration-disabled” for tasks that were actually migration-disabled.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explains that “Without CONFIG_PREEMPT_RCU, the prolog never touches migration_disabled,” yet the old code did `if (p->migration_disabled == 1) return p != current;`, and the fix changes it to apply the `p != current` disambiguation only when `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PREEMPT_RCU)`, otherwise returning `true` when `migration_disabled == 1`.
